up: Return the canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules that have been tested in assays targeting the human parathyroid hormone receptor (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1793).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1793' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
